mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested checking kitchen_table_k1 for early morning and coffee_table_l1 for evening, but at 22:59 it was at cupboard_k1. The "evening" window for coffee_table_l1 is narrower than assumed; by late night (22:00+), the mug is often stored in cupboard_k1. Check cupboard_k1 for late-night queries and coffee_table_l1 only for mid-evening (18:00-21:00).

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested checking desk_o1 for afternoon queries (13:00-17:00), but at 22:59 it was at dish_rack_k1. The "daytime" window for desk_o1 ends earlier than 17:00; by late night, the bottle is typically in dish_rack_k1. Check dish_rack_k1 for late-night queries (22:00+) and desk_o1 only for mid-day (10:00-16:00).

charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested checking nightstand_b1 for late evening (22:00-23:30), but at 14:46 it was at nightstand_b1 while I guessed desk_o1. This confirms the charger is at nightstand_b1 for a very broad window, including mid-afternoon. Check nightstand_b1 for almost all queries unless specific context indicates it is being used at the desk.

glass_tomas: Previous notes suggested checking nightstand_b1 for late-night queries (22:00-23:00), but at 21:02 it was at dining_table_d1. The "late night" window for nightstand_b1 starts later than 21:00. Check dining_table_d1 for early evening (19:00-21:30) and nightstand_b1 only for very late night (22:00+).
